# Category theory

See [@maclane1998]

## Introduction

### Natural transformation

See @eq-gauss and @thm-fubini.

::: {.theorem #fubini name="Fubini"}
Let $f \in L^1(X\times Y)$. Then
$$ \int_X\!\int_Y f(x,y)\,dy\,dx = \int_Y\!\int_X f(x,y)\,dx\,dy. $$
:::

::: {.definition #def-group}
A **group** is a set $G$ with a binary operation $\cdot$ satisfying:
1. Associativity: $(a\cdot b)\cdot c=a\cdot(b\cdot c)$;
2. Identity: $\exists e\in G$ such that $e\cdot a=a\cdot e=a$;
3. Inverses: $\forall a\in G\ \exists a^{-1}\in G$ such that $a\cdot a^{-1}=a^{-1}\cdot a=e$.
:::

::: {.example #ex-integers}
The set $\mathbb Z$ with addition is a group.
:::

::: {.lemma #lem-product}
The product of two integers is even if at least one factor is even.
:::

::: {.theorem #thm-primes}
There are infinitely many prime numbers.
:::

::: {.proof}
Assume finitely many primes $p_1,\dots,p_n$.  
Consider $P=p_1\cdots p_n+1$.  
$P>1$ has a prime divisor $p$, but $p$ divides neither $P-1$ nor $1$, contradiction.
:::

::: {.corollary #cor-next-prime}
For every integer $n\ge 2$ there exists a prime $p>n$.
:::

::: {.remark #rem-euclid}
Euclid's proof is constructive: it gives an upper bound on the next prime.
:::

Definition (Index set $\left(A_i\right)_{i \in I}$ )
$A: I \rightarrow X, i \mapsto A_i$
Definition (Product over the index set $\left(A_i\right)_{i \in I}$ )
$$
\prod_{i \in I} A_i:=\left\{a: I \rightarrow \bigcup_{i \in I} A_i \mid \forall i \in I, a(i) \in A_i\right\}
$$


Definition (Semigroup $(S, *)$ )

$$
*: S \times S \rightarrow S
$$

- Axiom 1 (Closure)

$$
\forall a, b \in S, a * b \in S
$$

- Axiom 2 (Associativity)

$$
\forall a, b, c \in S,(a * b) * c=a *(b * c)
$$


Example (Semigroup)

$$
(\mathbb{N},+), \mathbb{N}=\{1,2,3, \ldots\}, 0 \notin \mathbb{N}
$$


Definition (Commutative semigroup)

$$
\forall a, b \in S, a * b=b * a
$$


Definition (Non-commutative semigroup)

$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\forall a, b, c \in S,(a * b) * c=a *(b * c) \\
\exists x, y \in S, x * y \neq y * x
\end{array}\right.
$$

## ② 定理环境大合集

::: {.axiom #ax1 name="皮亚诺公理"}
自然数集 $\mathbb N$ 存在且唯一。
:::
见 @axm-ax1。

::: {.definition #def1 name="群"}
一个集合 $G$ 配备二元运算 $*$ 满足封闭性、结合律、单位元、逆元。
:::
见 @def-def1。

::: {.lemma #lem1 name="费马小引理"}
若 $p$ 是素数，则 $a^{p-1}\equiv 1\pmod p$。
:::
见 @lem-lem1。

::: {.proposition #prop1 name="命题示例"}
连续函数在闭区间上必取最值。
:::
见 @prop-prop1。

::: {.theorem #thm1 name="主定理"}
对任意右三角形，有 $$ a^{2}+b^{2}=c^{2}. $$ {#eq-pyth}
:::
见 @thm-thm1 与 @eq-pyth。

::: {.corollary #cor1 name="直接推论"}
斜边 $c=\sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}}$。
:::
见 @cor-cor1。

::: {.conjecture #conj1 name="哥德巴赫猜想"}
每个大于 2 的偶数都可写成两个素数之和。
:::
见 @conj-conj1。

::: {.example #ex1 name="具体例子"}
取 $a=3,b=4$，则 $c=5$。
:::
见 @exm-ex1。

::: {.remark #rem1 name="注记"}
上述证明可推广到任意希尔伯特空间。
:::
见 @rem-rem1。

::: {.assumption #ass1 name="基本假设"}
市场完全有效且不存在摩擦。
:::
见 @asm-ass1。

::: {.assertion #assr1 name="断言"}
本系统对所有输入皆停机。
:::
见 @assr-assr1。

::: {.proof}
留作习题，略。
:::
